verdict.summary: The release gui-bundle matrix replaces the source build with a SHA-pinned, architecture-aware prebuilt wasm-pack 0.15.0 installer, preserving the exact version used by the other wasm-pack lanes. The guardrail is job-scoped, strips comments, confirms an ARM64 matrix row, rejects both source compilation and the x86-only installer, and includes meaningful mutation checks for both regressions. The focused 17-test suite passes. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found.
